title: Autonomous profile curation and regression oracle for low-precision variants
creator: Asha Raman
description: Build an automated intake and verification pipeline that curates candidate quantization profiles (INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ), synthesizes compact canonical prompt sets, and runs a lightweight regression oracle to flag perf/quality regressions prior to publishing a profile. The system must produce a human-readable artifact (profile badge + summary) and a machine-readable signature used by rollouts and pinning. Aim to reduce manual triage by ~60% for new low-precision variants and provide deterministic, explainable accept/reject reasons for PM/ML review.
acceptance_criteria: Automated pipeline ingests model artifact and quant profile, runs a 3-stage check (sanity, perf smoke, quality oracle) and emits PASS/FAIL with reasons

Oracle metrics include: median token latency delta, p95 latency delta, end-to-end throughput change, top-1 token distribution KL, ROUGE/EM style quality delta on curated evals, and a synthesized adversarial divergence score
Profile artifact produced: JSON profile with version, numeric signatures, curated prompt index (<=200 prompts), human summary (200-400 chars), and a unique profile badge URL
Profiles that PASS auto-publish to staging catalog and are usable by canary routing for Dedicated/Hosted deployments
False-positive rate below 8% on a retrospective test set of 220 previously-approved profiles and false-negative rate below 5% on a set of known regressions
Dashboard shows per-profile time series and triage reasons; triage workflow links back to PRs and issue lanes for failed profiles
tasks: Design canonical prompt sampler and prioritized corpus (work with PM/QA to select ~200 prompts across intent buckets)
Implement lightweight quality oracle using top-k token divergence + small supervised eval suite (50 examples)
Instrument latency and memory telemetry hooks in runner to compute per-profile delta metrics
Build profile artifact schema and signature (JSON + SHA256) and register schema in registry
Create CI job that runs the oracle, stores artifacts in object store, and triggers dashboard ingestion
Integrate pipeline with rollout controller to allow staging pinning and automatic fallback on detected regressions
Run retrospective evaluation against historical profiles and iterate thresholds to meet acceptance targets
